doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tape change; California weather versus Florida and Ohio
summary: After a tape change Young compares Florida and Ohio humidity with California and says why he loves California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: …bands and things, and this was the state, I was down in Florida I was every place. I don‘t care for Florida, the weather and things, I like California. I don‘t mean anything about… I‘m talking about the weather and everything that‘s what I really meant when I said I didn‘t care for, I really didn‘t like the weather in Florida though because it gets too hot and too something…
Humid, that‘s what I‘m trying to say.
California used to, didn‘t be like that. It‘s getting kind of strange now though. [laughs] Don‘t you think?

It‘s changed, but when I first came out here, what I‘m talking about, there wasn‘t no such thing as humid. It was so beautiful, man. But it‘s changed, I think the whole world has changed, you know, and its too bad though, but California‘s not bad though, the humid it doesn‘t bother me because I‘m from the east where humid is… where are you from?
You from, well see? You from here, so you really don‘t know what I‘m talking about.
[laughs] But we‘ve lived all over. We lived all over. We both lived in Germany…
If you lived in Ohio in the summertime…
Night or day it‘s so hot, it don‘t change during the summertime and different things. They have times when, it don‘t change, the weather just, I don‘t know, and Florida‘s like that.
California it ain‘t like that. California‘s out there. That‘s why I come to California, I love California.
That‘s why I come to California.
